title: API tokens
lead: Tokens let agents use the wiki over MCP, with the permissions you give them.

unavailable.title: The server is not answering right now.
unavailable.detail: Your tokens cannot be shown. Reload this page in a moment.

list.title: Your tokens
list.none: No tokens yet. Create one below and give it to your agent.

name.label: Name
name.hint: Shown next to every change the agent makes. Up to {max} characters, different from your other tokens.

permissions.hint: What the agent may do. It never gets more than your own account. Delete moves notes and folders to the trash; agents can never delete for good.
permissions.guestHint: Guests can read and search only.

scope.label: Access
scope.hint: Limited to folders, the agent sees nothing outside them.

expiry.label: Expires
expiry.hint: After that the token stops working.

confirm.title: Confirm it’s you
confirm.detail: A token gives access to the wiki. Enter your password to create it.
confirm.passwordHint: For the next 10 minutes you will not be asked again.

created.heading: Token “{name}” created
created.hint: Give your agent the following configuration so it can set up the MCP server.
created.warning: Copy the configuration before you leave: the token cannot be shown again.

revoke.title: Revoke this token?
revoke.detail: Agents using it lose access with their next request. This cannot be undone.

unauthenticated.title: Signed out
unauthenticated.detail: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

invalid_password.title: Password not correct
invalid_password.detail: Check your password and try again.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.detail: Wait a moment, then try again.

name_taken.title: Name already used
name_taken.detail: Choose another name for this token.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.detail: Your account cannot give these permissions. The page shows what it can give now.

folder_not_found.title: Folder no longer there
folder_not_found.detail: A chosen folder was deleted meanwhile. Choose the folders again.

not_found.title: Token not found
not_found.detail: It may have been revoked already. The list is up to date again.

setup_token_present.title: Hexmark is blocked
setup_token_present.detail: SETUP_TOKEN is still set on the server. Ask the administrator to remove it.

database_unavailable.title: Database not reachable
database_unavailable.detail: The server cannot reach its database. Try again in a moment.

server_not_configured.title: Server not configured
server_not_configured.detail: The server is missing required settings. Ask the administrator.

server_unreachable.title: Server not reachable
server_unreachable.detail: The server is not answering. Try again in a moment.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.detail: The server gave an unexpected answer. Try again.
